detail.title: Partition type permanent magnetic suction tool
detail.abstract: The partition type permanent magnet suction tool is a method for making the whole machine generate magnetic force or not by utilizing the up-and-down movement of a permanent magnet between special polar plates; the advantages are that: 1, because the device has no inner and outer magnetic poles, the inner hole of the outer magnetic pole does not need to be processed, and a large amount of cutting-eliminating processing amount is saved; 2, in the movement of the upper layer and the lower layer of the permanent magnet, the permanent magnet does not turn over, so that most elastic resistance is basically eliminated; 3, the permanent magnets are directly arranged between the magnetic poles, and the space of the permanent magnets is far larger than that of the existing internal and external rotating magnetic poles, so that the permanent magnets can be placed more, and the magnetic force of the device is larger than that of the device.
inventors: THE INVENTOR HAS WAIVED THE RIGHT TO BE MENTIONED
